Cloud Run.name: Cloud Run
Cloud Run.description: Fully managed serverless container platform that autoscales containerized apps.
tradeoffs: Cost-effective for variable/low traffic, but might experience cold starts.
Cloud Run is cost-effective but may not suit ultra-low latency workloads.

Cloud Functions.name: Cloud Functions
Cloud Functions.description: Lightweight, event-driven serverless functions for single-purpose code.
tradeoffs: Simplest deployment with zero infrastructure management, but limited to single functions and short execution time limits.

BigQuery.name: BigQuery
BigQuery.description: Serverless, highly scalable multi-cloud data warehouse designed for business agility.
tradeoffs: Extremely fast analytical queries on massive tables, but high costs if queries scan large volumes without partitioning.

Cloud SQL PostgreSQL.name: Cloud SQL PostgreSQL
Cloud SQL PostgreSQL.description: Fully managed relational database service for PostgreSQL.
tradeoffs: Familiar relational engine with strong consistency and transactions, but requires manual sizing and is harder to horizontally scale.

GKE Autopilot.name: GKE Autopilot
GKE Autopilot.description: Fully managed, secure, and autoscaled Kubernetes environment with pay-per-pod pricing.
tradeoffs: GKE Autopilot is powerful but more complex than Cloud Run for a POC.
High scalability and control for multi-service microservice apps, but has a cluster management base cost.
GKE Autopilot.bom_unit: vCPU, RAM, Storage (per Pod hourly rate)

Cloud Storage.name: Cloud Storage
Cloud Storage.description: Highly durable and scalable object storage for files, backups, and static assets.
tradeoffs: Lowest cost storage for unstructured files, but retrieval charges and multi-regional latency must be managed.
Cloud Storage.bom_unit: GB Standard storage / month, Class A/B operations

Compute Engine.name: Compute Engine
Compute Engine.description: Secure and customizable virtual machines to run legacy workloads.
tradeoffs: Compute Engine gives control but increases operational effort.
Full OS control and hardware customizability, but requires patching, manual scaling configuration, and high base costs.
Compute Engine.bom_unit: Instance type (e.g. e2-medium) hours, Boot disk size

Cloud Spanner.name: Cloud Spanner
Cloud Spanner.description: Fully managed, globally distributed relational database with unlimited scale and strong consistency.
tradeoffs: Spanner improves scalability but increases cost compared to Cloud SQL.
Infinite horizontal database scale with schema consistency, but base cost starts high even for low instances.
Cloud Spanner.bom_unit: Processing Units (PU) per hour, storage capacity

Firestore.name: Firestore
Firestore.description: Flexible, serverless, scalable NoSQL document database for mobile, web, and server apps.
tradeoffs: Serverless scaling and real-time synchronization, but complex relational joins must be handled in application logic.
Firestore.bom_unit: Document reads, writes, deletes, storage size (GB)

Pub/Sub.name: Pub/Sub
Pub/Sub.description: Global, real-time, managed messaging service for decoupling applications.
tradeoffs: Highly scalable and asynchronous buffer, but guarantees at-least-once delivery, necessitating idempotent subscribers.
Pub/Sub.bom_unit: GB volume of messages published & retrieved

Cloud Load Balancing.name: Cloud Load Balancing
Cloud Load Balancing.description: High-performance, scalable software load balancing on Google's network.
tradeoffs: Enables secure, high-availability global traffic routing with SSL offloading, but adds base hourly gateway rules cost.
Cloud Load Balancing.bom_unit: Load balancer forwarding rule hours, LCU processing

Dataflow.name: Dataflow
Dataflow.description: Serverless stream and batch data processing pipeline based on Apache Beam.
tradeoffs: Robust stateful stream analytics processing, but pipelines require significant Java/Python SDK setup and worker overhead cost.
Dataflow.bom_unit: vCPU & RAM hours of processing workers

Memorystore.name: Memorystore
Memorystore.description: In-memory data store service for Redis and Memcached providing sub-millisecond latencies.
tradeoffs: Provides extremely fast cache stores for sub-millisecond latency, but standard tier features fixed instance billing.
Memorystore.bom_unit: 1 basic instance cache node, 1GB memory capacity

Bigtable.name: Bigtable
Bigtable.description: Sparse, highly scalable NoSQL database for large analytical and operational workloads.
tradeoffs: Bigtable is high-performance but overkill for small workloads.
Handles gigabytes-per-second throughput with low latency, but minimum node requirement is costly for minor datasets.

Cloud CDN.name: Cloud CDN
Cloud CDN.description: Content delivery network to accelerate app content delivery.
tradeoffs: Accelerates content delivery globally by caching at edge points, but cache invalidations can introduce latency lags.
Cloud CDN.bom_unit: Cache egress traffic (GB), HTTP cache requests

App Engine Standard.name: App Engine Standard
App Engine Standard.description: Zero-management app platform to deploy web and mobile backends.
tradeoffs: Extremely simple app deployment, but lacks the flexibility of custom docker runtimes provided by Cloud Run.
App Engine Standard.bom_unit: Instance F1 hours, outbound network bandwidth

Vertex AI.name: Vertex AI
Vertex AI.description: Unified artificial intelligence platform with access to Gemini LLM APIs and Vector Search.
tradeoffs: Allows direct access to cutting-edge AI models, but LLM pricing is token-based and can scale fast under high traffic.

Cloud Logging.name: Cloud Logging
Cloud Logging.description: Fully managed service that performs log storage, search, and analysis.
tradeoffs: Observability improves governance but adds monitoring cost and implementation effort.
Out-of-the-box log ingestion with high retention, but heavy logging can exceed free allowances.
Cloud Logging.bom_unit: GB of log data ingested (excluding 50GB free allowance)

Cloud Monitoring.name: Cloud Monitoring
Cloud Monitoring.description: Managed monitoring service tracking metrics, dashboards, and alerts.
tradeoffs: Observability improves governance but adds monitoring cost and implementation effort.
Granular dashboard tracking and automated alerting, but custom metrics API calls are charged per million.
Cloud Monitoring.bom_unit: Metric volume injected, custom metric API reads

Cloud Trace.name: Cloud Trace
Cloud Trace.description: Distributed tracing system collecting latency data from your apps.
tradeoffs: Observability improves governance but adds monitoring cost and implementation effort.
Excellent insights into microservice API latency hops, but requires code SDK instrumentation.
Cloud Trace.bom_unit: Million trace spans sent (after free quota)

Error Reporting.name: Error Reporting
Error Reporting.description: Counts, analyzes, and aggregates crashes and exceptions in running web services.
tradeoffs: Observability improves governance but adds monitoring cost and implementation effort.
Fully integrated crash diagnostics tool included for free with Google Logging ingestion.

VPC Service Controls.name: VPC Service Controls
VPC Service Controls.description: Mitigates data exfiltration risks by defining a security perimeter around Google API resources.
tradeoffs: Essential for banking PCI compliance and data exfiltration blocks, but highly complex configuration that can block normal APIs if misconfigured.

Private Google Access.name: Private Google Access
Private Google Access.description: Allows VMs with internal IPs only to reach public IPs of Google APIs and services.
tradeoffs: Enables secure, private connections to Google APIs without external IP addresses, but restricted to subnets and GCP networks.
